note: Abandoned places reported by news outlets and urbex coverage. Most are private property; check recent photos and ask permission.

spots.name: Lakeside Speedway
spots.location: Inside the Lakeside Amusement Park grounds, 4601 Sheridan Blvd, Lakeside
spots.condition: Closed in 1988 and still sitting abandoned next to the amusement park; used as a graveyard for old vehicles.

spots.name: South Platte Hotel
spots.location: South Platte, at the confluence of the North Fork and South Platte River, southwest of Denver
spots.condition: Built in 1912; bought by Denver Water and vacant ever since.
spots.access: Owned by Denver Water; local outlets warn against entering.

spots.name: Prairie Lodge Motel
spots.location: Roggen, Weld County, off I-76
spots.condition: Abandoned motel in the Roggen ghost town; ran for years after most of the town was left to rot.
spots.access: Private; outlets say visiting is prohibited for legal and safety reasons.

spots.name: Gilman (abandoned company town)
spots.location: Gilman, Eagle County, on US-24 near Minturn
spots.condition: Mining company town vacated over environmental contamination; buildings still standing.
spots.access: Private and an EPA cleanup site with contamination; view from the highway overlook.

spots.name: Crystal Mill
spots.location: Crystal, Gunnison County, Colorado
spots.condition: Century-old wooden mill above the Crystal River. In 2023 the owner closed the riverside trail below it after people partied inside.
spots.access: Private; the townsite road was still reachable in 2023 (4WD).

spots.name: Marble Ski Area lodge skeleton
spots.location: Marble, Colorado, Marble, Gunnison County
spots.condition: Unfinished, abandoned shell of a planned 200-room base lodge (~2019).

spots.name: Geneva Basin Ski Area
spots.location: Guanella Pass Road north of Grant, Grant area, Park County
spots.condition: Closed after 1983/84; the ski patrol building at the top of the old lift still stands (2019-2024).
spots.access: National forest, on foot from the gate.

spots.name: Echo Lake Lodge
spots.location: Echo Lake Lodge, Mount Blue Sky Road, Clear Creek County
spots.condition: Rustic lodge closed since October 2022; future uncertain.

spots.name: Animas Forks ghost town
spots.location: Animas Forks, Colorado, Animas Forks, San Juan County
spots.condition: About nine buildings standing, including the two-story Duncan House and the 1882 jail; stabilized 2013-14.

spots.name: Gold Prince Mill ruins
spots.location: Animas Forks, Colorado, Animas Forks, San Juan County
spots.condition: Steel-frame skeleton of the concentrating mill and the boarding-house foundation remain.

spots.name: Sound Democrat Mill
spots.location: Placer Gulch near Animas Forks, Placer Gulch, San Juan County
spots.condition: 1905 stamp mill, called the last standing stamp mill in the Eureka district and one of the most complete in Colorado.

spots.name: Old Hundred Mine boarding house
spots.location: Galena Mountain near Howardsville, Howardsville, San Juan County
spots.condition: 1908 boarding house clinging to a cliff at 12,500 ft; roof rebuilt and building cabled to the cliff.
spots.access: No road, only a mule trail.

spots.name: Yankee Girl Mine headframe
spots.location: Yankee Girl Mine, Ouray County, Red Mountain Pass, Ouray County
spots.condition: Mine closed ~1914; the timber headframe still stands and has been stabilized.
spots.access: Private; view from the US 550 pullout.

spots.name: National Bell Mine
spots.location: National Belle Mine, Ouray County, Red Mountain valley, Ouray County
spots.condition: Listed among Colorado's most amazing abandoned places.

spots.name: Ironton ghost town
spots.location: Ironton, Ouray County, Colorado
spots.condition: Three abandoned houses still stand, two being stabilized (2018).
spots.access: Public townsite trail. Legal to visit.

spots.name: Red Mountain Town jail
spots.location: Red Mountain Town, Colorado, Red Mountain Town, Ouray County
spots.condition: Most of the town burned in 1939; the jail is reported as the only structure still standing.

spots.name: Atlas Mill ruins
spots.location: Sneffels, Ouray County, Colorado
spots.condition: Remains of the 1890s-1920s Atlas Mill near Yankee Boy Basin.
spots.access: National forest; Camp Bird Road can close for rockfall.

spots.name: Alta ghost town
spots.location: Alta, San Miguel County, Colorado
spots.condition: About 20 structures standing, including the two-story 1939 boarding house; may now be fenced.

spots.name: Tomboy ghost town
spots.location: Tomboy, San Miguel County, Colorado
spots.condition: Mine closed 1927; cabins and a boarding house still stand (2017).

spots.name: Capitol City
spots.location: Capitol City, Colorado, Capitol City, Hinsdale County
spots.condition: The historic post office and a smelter stack remain standing.

spots.name: Bachelor-Commodore Mine Complex
spots.location: Commodore Mine, Creede, Creede, Mineral County
spots.condition: Ore house, trestles and buildings in poor condition at risk of collapse (2019 EPA); visible from the Bachelor Loop.
spots.access: Visible from a public interpretive route; Superfund site.

spots.name: St. Elmo ghost town
spots.location: St. Elmo, Colorado, St. Elmo, Chaffee County
spots.condition: About 40 buildings standing: saloon, courthouse, mercantile, church, school and homes.
spots.access: Town legal to visit; many buildings private.

spots.name: Mary Murphy Mine and tram stations
spots.location: Romley, Chaffee County, Colorado
spots.condition: Mine building remains, the boarding house and middle tram station visible along the road (2021).

spots.name: Winfield ghost town
spots.location: Winfield, Chaffee County, Colorado
spots.condition: A few structures standing, including the 1889 schoolhouse (now a museum) and cabins.
spots.access: Historical society; private cabins nearby. Legal to visit.

spots.name: Independence ghost town
spots.location: Independence, Pitkin County, Colorado
spots.condition: Several stabilized buildings remain below Independence Pass.
spots.access: National forest, Aspen Historical Society. Legal to visit.

spots.name: Ashcroft ghost town
spots.location: Ashcroft, Colorado, Ashcroft, Pitkin County
spots.condition: About 9-13 buildings remain: post office, saloons, hotel and mercantile.
spots.access: National forest, Aspen Historical Society. Legal to visit.

spots.name: Interlaken Resort
spots.location: Interlaken, Twin Lakes, Colorado, Twin Lakes, Lake County
spots.condition: 1880s resort hotel abandoned for decades; stabilized, still listed as vacant.
spots.access: Public, about a 4.7-mile hike. Legal to visit.

spots.name: Boston Mine (Mayflower Gulch)
spots.location: Mayflower Gulch trailhead on CO 91 south of Copper Mountain, Summit County; the mine is about 1.8 miles up the trail
spots.condition: About six decaying cabins, collapsed miners' quarters and rusting equipment above treeline (2023).
spots.access: Summit County open space, 1.8-mile hike. Legal to visit.

spots.name: Saints John ghost town
spots.location: Saints John, Colorado, Saints John, Summit County
spots.condition: About three cabins and a large concentrating mill remain.

spots.name: Dyersville
spots.location: Dyersville, Summit County, Colorado
spots.condition: Log cabins and roofless walls (sources disagree on how many).

spots.name: Reiling Gold Dredge
spots.location: French Gulch, Breckenridge, Breckenridge, Summit County
spots.condition: Gold dredge boat abandoned in a pond in 1922; stabilized in 2022.

spots.name: Camp Hale ruins
spots.location: Camp Hale, Colorado, Camp Hale, Eagle County
spots.condition: WWII 10th Mountain Division camp; concrete ruins along the Eagle River (a hiker found a landmine there in 2025).
spots.access: National monument; stay on marked routes. Legal to visit.

spots.name: Holy Cross City
spots.location: Holy Cross City, Colorado, Holy Cross City, Eagle County
spots.condition: Four scattered cabins and abandoned mining equipment (2017).

spots.name: Caribou ghost town
spots.location: Caribou, Boulder County, Colorado
spots.condition: Two stone building ruins and a collapsed log cabin, with graffiti inside.

spots.name: Nevadaville
spots.location: Nevadaville, Colorado, Nevadaville, Gilpin County
spots.condition: A saloon, the old city hall/fire house/jail and the Masonic lodge still stand (2018).

spots.name: Santiago Mine and Mill
spots.location: Santiago Mine, Clear Creek County, Waldorf, Clear Creek County
spots.condition: Abandoned mill on the state register, above Waldorf on the Argentine Pass road.

spots.name: Victor gold camp headframes
spots.location: Vindicator Valley Trail, Victor, Victor, Teller County
spots.condition: Many abandoned gold mines and steel and wooden headframes along an interpretive trail.

spots.name: Titan I missile silo complex near Deer Trail
spots.location: 82000 E County Road 22, about 4 miles NNE of Deer Trail, Deer Trail, Arapahoe County
spots.condition: Abandoned Titan I complex (missiles removed 1965). Teens fell inside in 2024 and 2025; fenced but the gate appeared damaged (2024).
spots.access: Private, fenced; trespassers cited. The state warns it is unsafe to enter.

spots.name: Aroya Schoolhouse
spots.location: Aroya, Colorado, Aroya, Cheyenne County
spots.condition: Abandoned double-arched wooden schoolhouse; roof rotting and caving in, bell tower still standing (2019).

spots.name: Last Chance Motel
spots.location: Last Chance, Colorado (US 36 and CO 71), Last Chance, Washington County
spots.condition: Derelict motel abandoned for years in a near-ghost town; a 2012 fire burned most of the town.

spots.name: Roggen abandoned main street
spots.location: Roggen, Colorado, Roggen, Weld County
spots.condition: About half the town is abandoned: a deserted main street, a gas station and about a dozen boarded-up homes and shacks (2015).
spots.access: Some residents remain; houses are boarded up.

spots.name: Keota ghost town (church, store, water tower)
spots.location: Keota, Colorado, Keota, Weld County
spots.condition: Weathered Methodist church, the old general store, houses, barns and a dead water tower in a mostly abandoned town (2022).
spots.access: A few residents nearby; respect private land.

spots.name: Dearfield
spots.location: Dearfield, Colorado (off US 34 east of Greeley), Dearfield, Weld County
spots.condition: Historic Black farming town: two or three century-old buildings remain, secured with fencing in 2021; National Park Service study underway.
spots.access: Fenced and secured; view from outside.

spots.name: Chivington School
spots.location: Chivington, Colorado (CO 96), Chivington, Kiowa County
spots.condition: Dilapidated two-story Italianate schoolhouse, closed by the 1960s (2015).
spots.access: Visible from the highway; a few families live in town.

spots.name: Arlington Schoolhouse
spots.location: Arlington, Kiowa County, Colorado
spots.condition: Two-story schoolhouse dominating a ghost town, with a couple of abandoned shacks (2017).
spots.access: Private; owner reportedly refused to sell.

spots.name: Galatea townsite
spots.location: Galatea, Colorado, Galatea, Kiowa County
spots.condition: A cluster of abandoned buildings and trees marks the townsite (2021).

spots.name: Boyero townsite
spots.location: Boyero, Colorado, Boyero, Lincoln County
spots.condition: Prairie ghost town with abandoned buildings along County Road 39 (2020).

spots.name: Pritchett grain elevators
spots.location: Pritchett, Colorado, Pritchett, Baca County
spots.condition: Three roughly ten-story grain elevators abandoned after the rail spur was removed (2012; follow-up 2026).

spots.name: Cabin Creek roadside stop
spots.location: Cabin Creek, near Byers, Colorado (US 36), Byers area, Adams County
spots.condition: Vacant roadside village (gas station, 8-room motel, cafe, houses) listed for sale in 2016; no newer info.

spots.name: Matheson abandoned church
spots.location: Matheson, Colorado, Matheson, Elbert County
spots.condition: Abandoned church surrounded by dead trees (2016).

spots.name: Great Western Sugar Factory (Longmont Sugar Mill)
spots.location: 11801 Sugar Mill Road, near Longmont, Longmont area (unincorporated), Boulder County
spots.condition: Closed in 1977 and vacant since. Repeated fires (2016, 2017, 2020, Aug 2024, Mar 2025) destroyed part of the landmark building. Firefighters say it is structurally unstable with hazardous materials; an explorer fell about 20 ft inside in Oct 2025. Newest info: 2025.
spots.access: Private property; explorers have been cited for trespassing. Owners say they are ready to sell.

spots.name: Former Denver VA Medical Center
spots.location: 1055 Clermont St, Denver, Denver (Hale), Denver County
spots.condition: Vacant since the new VA hospital in Aurora opened in July 2018: five buildings and a parking structure on 8.2 acres. Redevelopment proposals pending. Newest info: 2024.

spots.name: Zuni Steam Power Plant
spots.location: Zuni Street along the South Platte River, Denver, Denver (Sun Valley), Denver County
spots.condition: Built 1901; stopped generating in 2015 and supplying steam in 2019, now vacant. On Colorado's Most Endangered Places list (2024). Xcel said in 2025 it would demolish it if no buyer emerged, so check current status. Newest info: 2025.
spots.access: Owned by Xcel Energy, listed for sale.

spots.name: Valmont School
spots.location: Historic Valmont townsite, east of Boulder, Valmont, Boulder County
spots.condition: Two-room 1911 schoolhouse, closed 1951 and vacant since the early 1980s; failing roof and water-damaged bell tower. Colorado Most Endangered Place 2024. Newest info: 2024.

spots.name: Former Globeville church / senior center
spots.location: 4400 N Lincoln St, Denver, Denver (Globeville), Denver County
spots.condition: Former church, later a senior center; the city said in 2019 it had sat vacant for years. Newest info: 2019 (may have changed).
spots.access: Owned by the City of Denver.

spots.name: Abandoned family home off South Boulder Road
spots.location: Off E South Boulder Road, Lafayette (no exact address given), Lafayette, Boulder County
spots.condition: Abandoned house with furniture, TVs, toys and children's artwork left inside. Newest info: about 2022.
spots.access: Private; the station warns against trespassing.

spots.name: Old St. Francis Hospital
spots.location: 825 E Pikes Peak Ave, Colorado Springs, Colorado Springs, El Paso County
spots.condition: Closed in 2010; the site and its power plant are described as completely abandoned. Fire in the empty building in April 2023.
spots.access: Owned by 825 East Pikes Peak LLC (private).

spots.name: 'Little Log Cabin' daycare and two abandoned buildings
spots.location: 2024 East Boulder Street, Colorado Springs, Colorado Springs, El Paso County
spots.condition: A daycare and two other buildings at the address described as abandoned (radio-station feature, ~2020s).

spots.name: Vacant onion/hemp processing plant
spots.location: 20094 US Highway 50, Rocky Ford, Rocky Ford, Otero County
spots.condition: 44,649 sq ft plant built 1967, vacant since 2019/2020 (sale listing).

spots.name: Columbian Hotel
spots.location: 111 N Commercial St, Trinidad, Trinidad, Las Animas County
spots.condition: Upper two floors, about 100 rooms, vacant since the 1970s; listed for sale as a redevelopment project in March 2026.

spots.name: Walsen Power Plant
spots.location: Walsen Camp, west of Walsenburg, Walsenburg, Huerfano County
spots.condition: Vacant 1912 brick power plant, dark since 1972; neglect, vandalism and scrapping. Colorado Most Endangered Place. The only structure left of Walsen Camp.

spots.name: Former Lathrop Park juvenile facility
spots.location: Walsenburg, just east of the hospital, Walsenburg, Huerfano County
spots.condition: Closed boys' juvenile facility, buildings left empty (undated local article; may since have been reused).

spots.name: Deputy Warden's House
spots.location: Next to the Colorado State Penitentiary, Cañon City, Cañon City, Fremont County
spots.condition: State-owned historic house empty for years, no plans to reoccupy; on Colorado's endangered list in 2011.
spots.access: Colorado Department of Corrections, no public access.

spots.name: Herrick Sawmill
spots.location: Florence, Colorado, Florence, Fremont County
spots.condition: Abandoned sawmill more than 134 years old (Atlas Obscura).

spots.name: Loma School (1910)
spots.location: Loma, Colorado, Loma, Mesa County
spots.condition: Two-story 1910 school, closed 1982; cracked walls and boarded windows; vacated again in recent years over foundation problems (Feb 2026).

spots.name: Wiley's Resort Motel / Club 40 dance hall
spots.location: Just west of Dinosaur, along US Highway 40, Dinosaur, Moffat County
spots.condition: Long-closed resort motel and dance hall, still visible from Hwy 40 (2020s articles).

spots.name: Calamity Camp
spots.location: Calamity Mesa, Uncompahgre Plateau, via Niche Road east of Gateway (4x4), near Gateway, Mesa County
spots.condition: Uranium camp used ~1916-1980: five rock cabins, a bunkhouse, cellars, a barn and corrals remain; stabilized by HistoriCorps in 2024. Some residual radiation.
spots.access: BLM public land (National Register). Legal to visit.

spots.name: Summitville ghost town
spots.location: Summitville, about 18 miles southwest of Del Norte, Summitville, Rio Grande County
spots.condition: About two dozen abandoned buildings in a meadow and on the hillside; restoration in progress (2020). Next to a Superfund mine site.
spots.access: National forest road access; don't touch the structures.

spots.name: Far View Visitor Center
spots.location: Far View, Mesa Verde National Park, Mesa Verde National Park, Montezuma County
spots.condition: Mid-century Mission 66 visitor center, mothballed and vacant since ~2012-2014; Colorado Most Endangered Place 2023.

spots.name: La Morada (Penitente morada)
spots.location: San Luis, Colorado, San Luis, Costilla County
spots.condition: 1860s Penitente meeting building, vacant for over 50 years, collapsed walls; on the 2026 Most Endangered Places list.

spots.name: M&M Truck Stop
spots.location: US 491 south of Cortez, near the Port of Entry, south of Cortez, Montezuma County
spots.condition: Abandoned truck stop (Four Corners Free Press 'Derelicts' photo essay, date unclear).

spots.name: Cardiff Coke Ovens
spots.location: Cardiff, south of Glenwood Springs along Airport Road, Glenwood Springs, Garfield County
spots.condition: About 50 of the 249 1887 beehive coke ovens survive as ruins; being stabilized (2023).
spots.access: Glenwood Springs Historical Society; National Register.

spots.name: Ludlow ghost town
spots.location: About a mile from the Ludlow Massacre Memorial, off I-25 north of Trinidad
spots.condition: A dozen or so mostly intact structures including a stone jail, two one-room schoolhouses and a partly collapsed building with a piano inside (2016); several original buildings still standing.
spots.access: Monument visitable year round; ownership of the structures unknown.

spots.name: Berwind and Tabasco coal camp ruins
spots.location: Berwind Canyon, southwest of Ludlow
spots.condition: Decaying ruins of the coal camps closed by CF&I in 1928.

spots.name: First State Bank of Aguilar
spots.location: Aguilar, Colorado
spots.condition: Abandoned bank building (2015 blog; current condition unverified).

spots.name: Cokedale coke ovens
spots.location: Across Highway 12 from Cokedale, west of Trinidad
spots.condition: Ruins of the 1907 coke ovens, the largest surviving group in the state (2022).

spots.name: Pritchett Soda Shop
spots.location: Pritchett, Colorado
spots.condition: Abandoned soda shop (2015 blog; current condition unverified).

spots.name: Goldfield City Hall and ghost town
spots.location: About 1 mile north of Victor on CO 67, Goldfield, Teller County
spots.condition: Partial ghost town; the 1899 city hall and fire station and a few building remains stand.

spots.name: 855 Main Street abandoned storefront
spots.location: 855 Main Street, Silver Plume
spots.condition: Abandoned former bookstore and antique shop (also a residence) with its contents still inside.

spots.name: Colorado Central Mill (Silverdale)
spots.location: Silverdale Trailhead off Guanella Pass Road above Georgetown
spots.condition: Concrete 1920s mill structure and rusted iron left from the Silverdale mining camp.
spots.access: Owned by Georgetown; public trail. Legal to visit.

spots.name: Hessie townsite cabins
spots.location: Hessie Trailhead west of Eldora
spots.condition: Town deserted by 1905; small cabins remain along the trail.
spots.access: National forest trail. Legal to visit.

spots.name: Wellington Ore Bin
spots.location: French Gulch, B&B Trailhead, Breckenridge
spots.condition: Five-level 1880s ore bin, stabilized in 2016, with graffiti.

spots.name: Iowa Hill mining site
spots.location: Iowa Hill trail off Boreas Pass Road, Breckenridge
spots.condition: Abandoned hydraulic placer mining area with sluices and an 1870s boarding house.
spots.access: Public interpretive trail. Legal to visit.

spots.name: Leadville Mill
spots.location: California Gulch, Leadville
spots.condition: Dormant mill; a contested proposal would reopen it (2024).

spots.name: Sterling Great Western Sugar Factory
spots.location: US 6 at the southern edge of Sterling
spots.condition: Sugar factory that ran 1905-1985; idle factory and water tower still standing (2009); part of the site may be used for storage.

spots.name: Romantic Motor Vu Drive-In
spots.location: Craig, Colorado
spots.condition: Abandoned drive-in; the screen was still standing in Aug 2022 Street View.

spots.name: Merri-Land amusement park remnants
spots.location: Just west of Rossum Drive, Loveland
spots.condition: Small 1968-1970s park mostly destroyed in the 1976 flood; a possible ticket booth and pavilion are still visible from Rossum Drive.
spots.access: Private; view from Rossum Drive only.

spots.name: Apache Court Motel
spots.location: Manitou Springs historic district
spots.condition: Abandoned motel with a decaying sign (photo, undated).

spots.name: Colorado Building and theater (Pueblo)
spots.location: 401 N Main St, Pueblo
spots.condition: 1925 Art Deco building; the 1,000-seat theater has been closed since the 1970s and most offices have been vacant since 2005. For sale (Jan 2024).

spots.name: Rugby abandoned general store
spots.location: About 100 yards west of I-25 at Exit 41 (Rugby Road), about 15 miles north of Trinidad
spots.condition: Red brick abandoned general store (2015; no newer confirmation).

spots.name: Redstone Coke Ovens
spots.location: Along Highway 133 at Redstone
spots.condition: About 90 coke ovens abandoned for over a century; several restored (CPR, Dec 2025).
spots.access: Public historic site; legal to view.

spots.name: Birch Ruins
spots.location: Knoll-Willows Open Space, Estes Park
spots.condition: Stone walls and fireplace of a bungalow left standing since a 1907 fire (2023).
spots.access: Public open space; legal to visit.

spots.name: Rio Cucharas Inn
spots.location: Off US 160 heading east, a little past Lathrop State Park, Walsenburg
spots.condition: Closed to guests around 2016-2018; 2020 drone footage shows trash, Kokopelli murals on the adobe walls and swallows nesting in the rafters. Once had an Olympic-size indoor pool.

spots.name: A-Frame Lounge
spots.location: 8801 Interstate 76 Frontage Road, Henderson
spots.condition: Defunct 1964 A-frame lounge (5,280 sq ft) with wings on both sides; listed for sale in 2019; virtual tour around 2020-2022.

spots.name: 1925 farm near Frederick
spots.location: Near Frederick (exact spot not given)
spots.condition: Farm from 1925 abandoned for close to 30 years (photo gallery, undated).

spots.name: 2100 Larimer St (Monfort building)
spots.location: 2100 Larimer St, Denver
spots.condition: Still empty five years after planned renovations began; part of the roof caved onto the street and the city labeled it neglected and derelict (~2024-2025).

spots.name: Former Sears store, Monaco and Evans
spots.location: Monaco Parkway and Evans Avenue, Denver
spots.condition: Vacant, blighted former Sears that attracts dumping and camping (~2023-2024); the city has pushed to remove it, so check it still stands.

spots.name: Altona Schoolhouse
spots.location: Heil Valley Ranch open space, near Lyons
spots.condition: Abandoned historic schoolhouse and ranch buildings (virtual tour, undated).
spots.access: Public open space; building entry rules unknown.

spots.name: Colorado Motorsports Park / Byers Race Track
spots.location: 2050 S County Road 201, Byers
spots.condition: Built as a greyhound track and later used as Colorado Motorsports Park; called 'the abandoned racetrack in Byers' on Reddit (2026).
spots.access: Private; listed for sale or lease.

spots.name: Model
spots.location: Along US 350 between Trinidad and La Junta, Model, Las Animas County
spots.condition: Abandoned village; many abandoned homes, some apparently left with belongings inside, weathered rather than vandalized (2016 blog; Reddit thread 2026).

spots.name: Tyrone schoolhouse
spots.location: Tyrone, near Model
spots.condition: Abandoned schoolhouse with junk in the schoolroom and old desks in the basement (2016); construction equipment suggested possible renovation.

spots.name: St. Aloysius Church ruins, Morley
spots.location: Former coal camp at Morley, south of Trinidad near I-25
spots.condition: 1917 concrete-block church abandoned by 1956; the rest of the camp was demolished but the church shell still stands.
spots.access: Private; the owner reportedly allows visitors who ask permission first.

spots.name: Unfinished Grand Junction Regional Airport building
spots.location: Grand Junction Regional Airport grounds
spots.condition: About $4M spent on a building left unfinished and empty since 2013 after the FAA pulled funding (~2019 report).

spots.name: Arroyo School
spots.location: Near La Veta
spots.condition: Abandoned shell of Arroyo School (photographer's print listing, undated).

spots.name: Elephant Rock property (former Living Word Fellowship compound)
spots.location: Elephant Rock, Palmer Lake
spots.condition: 28-acre former camp with main buildings and seven cabins, described in 2024 as abandoned with buildings intact, as if members left one morning.
spots.access: Owned by the Town of Palmer Lake; future being decided.

spots.name: Creepy abandoned barn off Huron Street
spots.location: Off Huron Street, Northglenn
spots.condition: Abandoned barn shown in a YouTube video with dolls and nooses hanging inside (undated); a nearby barn fire was reported, so check it still stands.

spots.name: Former Encounter Church building
spots.location: Denver south suburbs (exact building unconfirmed), Englewood, Arapahoe County
spots.condition: Former school, then shopping center, then megachurch; abandoned since 2017 per write-ups of a YouTube urbex video.

spots.name: Abandoned Broomfield homestead ('TV graveyard')
spots.location: Broomfield (exact spot not given)
spots.condition: Main house, three-car garage and silo with a field of old TVs; belongings left behind (urbex photos, undated).

spots.name: Abandoned 1952 farmhouse
spots.location: Near 82nd Avenue, Arvada (one source)
spots.condition: 1952 farmhouse, heavily vandalized with graffiti and signs of squatting (undated).

spots.name: Prosser Gulch mining remains
spots.location: Prosser Gulch between Central City and Nevadaville
spots.condition: Stone, wood and metal buildings, old homes and a rusty car, described as structurally unsound (undated).
